title: Corrupt scan evidence: stored peaks of 3.7 on a pole that can't exceed 0.170
bug: The scan stage of this record (harness 0.0.15, mps:0) stored activations that GPT-2 L11/N1071's negative pole can't produce. GELU is never below about -0.170, so the pole is never above 0.170. The record stores peaks up to 3.72 and a histogram tail up to 3.70. Re-measured on MPS and CPU, its top examples peak at 0.170. The stored values match no GPT-2 or Qwen2.5-0.5B neuron. So the top examples, histogram, confounds, lenses and attribution don't describe this pole. The probes and counterfactuals were measured within the bound, so the verdict was measured on the right unit, but it rests on evidence the proposer never saw correctly. The cause was not reproduced (#4581). The fix stops a scan above the pole's ceiling.
